channel.title: The Australian Mining Review - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Australian Mining Review (australianminingreview.com.au)

item.title: Fortescue removes high-risk rodenticides from operations
item.description: Fortescue has removed second-generation anticoagulant rodenticides (SGARS) from its operations, in a move to reduce risks to native wildlife, including threatened species such as the Northern Quoll.

item.title: Metso expands lifecycle services model
item.description: Metso has reported increased demand in its Life Cycle Services (LCS) offering for pumps as mining operators shift towards long-term service-based equipment models.

item.title: MinRes ships first ore from Lamb Creek
item.description: Mineral Resources (ASX: MIN) has delivered first ore on ship from its Lamb Creek iron ore project in WA’s Pilbara region.

item.title: Meeka Metals begins ore sorting upgrade at Murchison
item.description: Meeka Metals (ASX: MEK) has commenced installation of an ore sorting facility at its Murchison gold project in WA, targeting increased processing capacity and higher gold production.

item.title: Global energy crisis now ‘largest in history’
item.description: Long gone are the days of sub dollar prices at the bowser.

item.title: Japan and South Korea accelerate nuclear growth
item.description: The Middle East conflict is reinforcing energy security as a central pillar of power planning in Japan and South Korea.

item.title: Deep sea mining talks deadlocked
item.description: International Seabed Authority (ISA) Council negotiations have concluded without the adoption of an agreed upon mining code and without any mining approvals being granted.

item.title: MCA pushes for $13m AI trial proposal
item.description: The Minerals Council of Australia (MCA) has asked the Federal Government to fund a three-year pilot program to embed AI into environmental regulatory decision-making.

item.title: Billion-dollar copper project to deliver local benefits
item.description: The post Billion-dollar copper project to deliver local benefits appeared first on The Australian Mining Review.

item.title: Liberty Bell Bay smelter enters voluntary administration
item.description: Liberty Bell Bay in Tasmania, one of billionaire Sanjeev Gupta’s last remaining Australian assets, has entered voluntary administration.
